carpet.rule.alwaysSweepAttack.desc: Always triggers a sweep attack when an attack with a sword in the main hand succeeds, ignoring attack cooldown, critical-hit checks, sprinting, grounded state, and movement speed limits
carpet.rule.convenientTotemOfUndying.des: Totems of Undying can trigger their protection from any slot of a player's inventory, excluding items stored inside shulker boxes or ender chests
carpet.rule.customBlockingKnockbackStren: Custom knockback strength applied to the attacker after an item blocks a melee attack
carpet.rule.deflectableWitherSkulls.desc: Players can left-click wither skulls of the selected colors to deflect them in the direction they are aiming
carpet.rule.enhancedTotemOfUndying.desc: Totems of Undying immediately restore an additional 10 health when triggered
carpet.rule.evokerNeverSummonVex.desc: Evokers will no longer attempt to summon vexes
carpet.rule.stackableTotemOfUndying.desc: Allows totems of undying to stack up to 64
carpet.rule.undeadNotImmuneToPoison.desc: Undead mobs are no longer immune to poison effects and will take normal poison damage
carpet.rule.witchNeverUseHarmingPotion.d: Witches will no longer attempt to throw instant damage potions
